name: Tax_Administration_Real_Estate_Dwelling_Data
title: Tax Administration Real Estate Dwelling Data
description:
This table contains information about the structure on the parcel including year built, number of bedrooms and bathrooms and style for properties within Fairfax County. There is a one-to-many relationship to the parcel data. Refer to this document for descriptions of the data on the table. The dwelling data is extracted daily from the DTA system.

Contact: Fairfax County Department of Information Technology GIS Division

Data Accessibility: Publicly Available

Update Frequency: Daily
